title: Phishing
summary: Phishing is tricking people into revealing passwords, OTPs or bank details through fake messages, calls or websites. Banks never ask for OTPs or PINs; check sender addresses and don't click unexpected links.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
